name: Kestra
summary: Start a run of an approved Ogun workflow from a Kestra flow, wait for it and expose the run id, state and artifact digests as outputs. Kestra calls Ogun and cannot approve.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: Credential name
fields.help: The blueprint connects as kestra (ogun credentials add kestra --kind agent). Edit the Client.connect call to use another name.

settings.name: workflow
settings.label: Ogun workflow
settings.help: Name of the stored Ogun workflow. A flow input.

settings.name: workflow_hash
settings.label: Pinned workflow hash
settings.help: The hash a person reviewed and approved. The run binds to it. A flow input.

settings.name: partition
settings.label: Partition key
settings.help: One partition key. Empty runs the latest partition. A flow input.

egress.note: Both tasks use the Process task runner on the ogund host and reach ogund through its local socket (O-15 section 2); nothing leaves the host.

implementation.evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS names no check of the Kestra blueprint. The Java plugin task io.verne.ogun.Run is not built.

notes: A flow blueprint, not a plugin: a Commands task runs ogun validate --json and ogun hash --json against the pinned hash, then a Python Script task starts the run with ogun-client. A Schedule trigger runs yesterday's partition at 04:15.
